[b][size=4]Clear Monocle[/size][/b] is a fork of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21090]Clear Glasses[/url], but it has been cut down for a narrower goal: keep xBRZ smoothing and remove systems that were adding load-time cost, runtime hooks, or compatibility risk.

[size=4][b]What is different?[/b][/size]
Clear Monocle only uses xBRZ. Other scaler paths were removed. Saturation, brightness, and temperature options were also removed.
The texture file cache, startup texture precache, SMAPI image patch replacement, and GetData texture patch are not part of the default path. This keeps texture loading closer to SMAPI’s normal behavior and helps avoid missing or broken textures in large mod lists.
Several expensive runtime behaviors were also cleaned up, including forced garbage collection on common game events, per-frame CPU affinity checks, per-frame thread priority changes, parallel Harmony patching, and extra startup compression/cache work.

[b][size=4]Profiler comparison[/size][/b]
In my profiler comparison, Clear Monocle had much lower startup and event impact than the original Clear Glasses build.
Raw SMAPI assembly/load block went from about 7 seconds to about 1 second or less, roughly [color=#ffff00]6 seconds faster[/color].
The direct GameLoop.GameLaunched handler went from 704.67 ms to 15.26 ms, about [color=#ffff00]46 times faster[/color].
The launch stage including mod invalidations went from about 731.07 ms to 41.94 ms, about [color=#ffff00]17 times faster[/color].
Save-loaded impact went from about 6,647.88 ms to 3.06 ms, about [color=#ffff00]2,171 times faster[/color].
Day-start impact went from about 2,984.50 ms to 7.86 ms, about [color=#ffff00]380 times faster[/color].
Total profiled impact in the log went from about 10,388.63 ms to 78.50 ms, about [color=#ffff00]132 times faster[/color].

[color=#00ff00][size=4]F11 will toggle the mod on or off.[/size][/color]
